title: Spiritual India
description: The birthplace of yoga and meditation — where the Ganges glows with a thousand lamps and silence speaks the loudest. #india #spirituality #yoga #varanasi

scenes.text: India is where the world learned to look inward.
The birthplace of yoga and meditation.
Where the sacred Ganges glows with a thousand floating lamps.
Where temple bells and chants fill the morning air.
Where millions seek peace, not in noise, but in silence.
In India, spirituality isn't a religion. It's a way of life.
